children: Post hoc analysis of the PreciSION CF Phase 2a trial revealed that removing confounded participants showed evidence of NBD1 target engagement, with a mean sweat chloride reduction of up to -8.6 mmol/L. The preferred dual combination, SION-451 + SION-2222, demonstrated favorable safety and is advancing to a Phase 2a proof-of-concept trial in 1Q27.
